# A long document for search marks and selection

Press Ctrl+F and type `e`: every match is marked, thousands of them. Scroll
with the wheel and the scrollbar, then close Find, press Ctrl+A and scroll
again. Scrolling should stay as smooth as with nothing marked, at a narrow
width as at a wide one. `highlight_layout` builds the same sections for its
own checks.

## Section 0 of the long document

The **bold 0** words, the *italic ones*, `code`, [a link](#section-0) and ==marked text== run over the edge of a narrow window, so the paragraph wraps onto several lines of words and each line has runs of its own.

- item one of 0
- item two with **weight**
  - a nested item

| Left 0 | Right |
| --- | --- |
| alpha | beta **bold** |
| gamma | delta |

```cpp
int value0 = 0; // the letters of a fence
```

> A quote with x^2^ and H~2~O in the text of it.
